Angela joined SWEAT440 Coral Gables looking for workouts that would challenge her, keep her motivated, and fit into her busy schedule. From her very first class, she fell in love with the energy, the structure, and the incredible sense of accomplishment after every workout. She has now completed close to 400 classes and loves that no two classes are ever the same, with each session bringing a new challenge while delivering an efficient, fun, and effective workout in just 40 minutes. Whether it’s Latin beats or house music keeping the energy high, she’s always ready to push herself outside her comfort zone.

Her advice to anyone nervous about trying their first class is simple: just show up. Everyone starts somewhere, and the SWEAT440 community is welcoming, supportive, and encouraging every step of the way. On days when motivation is low, she reminds herself that she’s never regretted finishing a workout. For her, fitness is about so much more than appearance; it’s about feeling strong, healthy, and taking care of both her physical and mental well-being.

She describes the SWEAT440 community in three words: supportive, motivating, and inspiring. Outside of the gym, she’s incredibly proud of building her jewelry brand, Iveta, alongside her sister and daughter. Watching something they created with love grow over the years has been deeply rewarding. She’s also passionate about using her social media platform to inspire others to embrace a healthier lifestyle through fitness, nutrition, and wellness, making her a true inspiration both inside and outside the studio.

Thanks, Angela, for being part of the SWEAT440 Coral Gables Family! 💙
